body.x: RF(president: Soon Bok Lee) will exhibit Windowmate, a glass window cleaning robot, at the Consumer Technology Show (CES) 2017, which is the world's largest IT appliance exhibition in Las Vegas from January 5 to 8, preparing concrete results in the global market.
In 2016, WindowMate participated in major exhibitions and local export conferences around the world to show and present products directly to global buyers and consumers.

It visited in various regions of Asia, America, Europe like German IFA, Innorobo France, Hong Kong Electronics Show, Dubai GITEX, Beijing WRC Robot Exhibition, Shanghai CIROS, China Jinan Korea Distribution Product Exhibition, Singapore SIRE and Information Communication Expo, Vietnam Hochimin Korean Product Exhibition, India Market Pioneer, Daegu Middle East Trade Mission, Sungnam City USA Marketplace pioneer export consultation, Korea AVING MIK, Korea World IT Show, Korea Robotics Society KROS, etc to show its marketability and value.

In Korea, the company has promoted the e-land contract and promotional sales at the Pangyo branch of Hyundai Department Store. In addition, the company is planning to establish a branch office in all Electromart and to enter Macao in Hong Kong.

In addition to 20 exhibitions and conferences, sales and export contracts last year, the company did not hesitate to develop internal products, develop technology, and develop new products, such as new product development and factory expansion.

At CES 2017, the company won two CES 2017 Innovation Awards in recognition of this series of various activities, and the technology and innovation of the service robots made in Korea were recognized. In addition, it had the honor of winning the Korea Robot Industry Promotion Agency's Best Robot Company Award and 2016 Korea Robot Company of the Year by Robot Newspapers.

In addition, it was selected as AVING MIK TOP 3 and World IT Show 2016 Best of Top 10, and was selected as Small and Medium Business Promotion Corporation's HIT500 product and the medium-term product of July Small Business Administration / Korea Economic Daily.

"I gave serious effort without rest last year. I declared a different strategy from other electronic products and selected a special item called window cleaning, and went directly to the global market to overcome the lack of awareness of consumers. Now, many buyers and consumers are aware of WindowMate," said Mr. Lee. "I had a hard time investing a lot of money and manpower, but I was able to understand the local market and culture around the world, and show the technology power of South Korea, I can tell you" said Mr. Lee.

WindowsMate expects 2017 to be a year of real harvesting based on its global activities in 2016 and will move forward throughout the company to do its best to ensure that WindowMate is sold and installed worldwide.

Windowmate expects to reach $ 10 million in revenue in 2017, with more than $ 1 million in four countries including Germany, France, Austria, and Switzerland and more than $ 6 million in Asian markets such as Korea, Japan, China and India.
